mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_tenant ut ON ut.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND ut.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ut.status = 1 AND m.status = 1 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.order_num, m.path, m.icon, m.perms, m.visible, m.status, m.create_time, m.update_time FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_tenant ut ON ut.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND ut.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ut.status = 1 AND m.status = 1 AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num
